company.name: SendHub
company.shortDescription: SendHub is a business messaging platform enabling SMS campaigns, automation, and customer communication management tools
company.description:
SendHub is the Phone System for the Mobile World. There's no hardware, setup is instant and it scales elastically with a single click. Users are given a phone number in any area code, they can use from any device: Web, iPhone, Android, Feature Phones and via our API.

Businesses can add lines for everyone on their team for free, with complete transparency and powerful analytics on every aspect of your telecommunication.

Additional Features: 
Auto Attendant, 
Call Transfer, 
Company Directory, 
Contact Sharing, 
Voicemail Transcription, 
Text Marketing & Group Texting, 
Free Internal Communication.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,996,566 to $27,557,565, a 3.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 32 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 4 (-12).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
